method: Fresh independent read-only review of all109 deployment and63 tooling/documentation paths from the frozen1901-file inventory. Read AGENTS.md and honored the user requirement for TWO clean complete rounds rather than the repository default of three. Fully read executable production sources, test implementations, workflows, configuration and prose, repairing every truncated read. Followed acquisition and fixed-runtime verification, bounded isolated builds and source publication, identity/permission ownership, configuration/provider transactions and CAS, service stop/activity/cgroup/process proof, durable journals and install/control-update/release/uninstall recovery, descriptor filesystem authority, workspace/index/commit/worktree state and supervisor witnesses. Traced HTTPS default/custom ports, Caddy and AliDNS recipe/build pins, root-private credential generations, certificate issuance and renewal configuration, TLS/SNI/CA/hostname verification, HMAC gateway authentication, rollback snapshots and DNS generation retention. Cross-checked recovery and operator instructions against those implementations. Read all54 deployment test/probe paths as boundary assertions, without executing tests. Read CI selection, clean environment, native/Go provisioning, Vitest/Python/Go execution evidence, cross-platform report reconciliation, source-bound full-test authorization, independent review accounting, release secret scanning and Windows controller preflight plus all assigned tests/workflows. Structurally and semantically checked all1510 go.sum records (611 modules,166 selected module/go.mod pairs), exact four-file Go recipe pins, all3112 pnpm-lock lines including336 packages/336 snapshots and623 dependency edges, importer/specifier/override consistency, integrity formats and engine/platform declarations. Fully read19 smaller feature-evidence JSON files; parsed all20 JSON documents (8346 values,1293 objects,zero duplicate keys). For large capability-coverage.json reviewed every unique assessment, all178 typed method mappings,50 groups and15 additional workflows; validated typed parameter sources, all175 JSON pointers, classification/status counts,559 reference records and532 references to371 current-source paths. Confirmed historical test skips remain explicit and those current documentation artifacts claim zero formal clean rounds; their recorded results were not used as this audit or current test proof. No old checkout, Git history or prior formal audit reports were used. Before and after this review, verified all1901 raw SHA256 inventory hashes and exported canonical snapshot(process.cwd(),true) from scripts/snapshot.mjs using the pinned Node24.22.1 runtime; both canonical digests exactly match the freeze. No source edits, test-suite execution, remote/live integrations or candidate repro were performed. Audit writes are limited to ignored .work evidence files.
limitations: This is a complete assigned-source audit, not execution of the test suite; no full or targeted tests were run. Test files were inspected in full and no defect candidate required a local reproducer.

No new Linux/systemd deployment, cross-UID integration, package download, DNS-provider call, public network reachability probe, real ACME issuance/renewal, external account/OAuth operation, paid model invocation or browser acceptance was executed. Live availability and future certificate renewal are not established by static review.

Current feature-evidence documents were audited as assigned documentation. Their point-in-time reports, prior source hashes and external-service claims were not reopened or promoted to current frozen-snapshot proof.
